svg.aria-label: The PCP8 by DCP8 prefill engine. Left: the KV cache as stored, each of 8 GPUs holding every 8th block. Right: during each attention layer, after an all-gather, every GPU holds a full-context copy of the KV and computes two query chunks of this step, g and 15 minus g
svg.text: Where the KV and queries live in the PCP8 × DCP8 prefill engine
a full-context copy; queries split by chunk (PCP8)
KV received in the all-gather, freed after the layer
queries this GPU computes (chunks g and 15 − g)
